The first changed-file attempt failed for an absent FLINT addon; that failure is retained. Authorized documented native preparation and one unchanged rerun passed, including the normal docs-triggered rebuild with all five adapters current and 41 native kernel families published. No PR219 ancestry, mathematical API, package/registry, runtime-cap or source-allowance change is included. Historical receipts are not current qualification.
